idea-plugin.name: Deep Project Search
idea-plugin.description:
Deep Project Search

Deep Project Search adds a dedicated IntelliJ IDEA tool window for searching both current project files, project text content, dependency jar entries, and dependency text resources in one place.

It is designed for cases where Search Everywhere may miss files inside dependency jars until those classes or resources have been opened once.

How to use

  • Open the Deep Search tool window.
  • Enter a keyword such as UserService, spring.factories, or META-INF services.
  • Choose All, Project Files, or Dependencies.
  • Click Search, or press Enter from the keyword field.
  • Double-click a result, or press Enter on the selected result, to open the project file, jar resource, or class file.
  • Use recent searches from the keyword dropdown to rerun previous queries.
  • Use quick actions to open results, copy paths, or clear the result list.

Features

  • Searches current project files.
  • Searches project text file contents.
  • Searches dependency class and source roots, including jar entries.
  • Searches dependency text resources and source content where available.
  • Supports filename, path, and text content keyword matching.
  • Shows a preview line for project and dependency content matches.
  • Opens text content matches directly at the matched line and column when possible.
  • Keeps recent search history.
  • Provides quick actions for opening results, copying paths, and clearing results.
  • Provides scope selection without taking over the double-Shift shortcut.
  • Runs searches in a background task.

中文说明

Deep Project Search 是一个独立的 IDEA 搜索工具窗口，用来统一搜索当前项目文件和依赖 jar 内部的 class/resource 文件，也支持搜索项目和依赖中的文本内容。它不会占用 IDEA 双击 Shift 的快捷键。

适合搜索依赖包里的 .class、META-INF、.properties、 .xml、.yml 等文件，也可以同时搜索当前项目文件和文本内容。 文本内容命中会显示预览，并在可行时直接跳转到命中行。输入框会保留最近搜索记录， 结果列表支持打开、复制路径和清空等快捷操作。
